package idlesim

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestIdleSimCatalogRejectsBadReloadAndKeepsFrozenRecipe(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	write := func(r Rules) {
		t.Helper()
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(r)
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "idle.json"), raw, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	r := DemoRules()
	write(r)
	store, err := OpenCatalog(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snapshot := store.Current()
	old, err := CaptureRules(snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	bad := r
	bad.Recipes[0].Work = 0
	write(bad)
	if _, err := store.Reload(context.Background()); err == nil || store.Current() != snapshot {
		t.Fatal("bad config replaced snapshot")
	}
	r.Version = "new"
	r.Recipes[0].Raw = 5
	write(r)
	if _, err := store.Reload(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	current, err := CaptureRules(store.Current())
	if err != nil || current.Hash() == old.Hash() || old.Recipes[0].Raw != 2 {
		t.Fatal("frozen config changed")
	}
}
func TestIdleSimSegmentedTimeMatchesSingleIntegration(t *testing.T) {
	const now int64 = 1800000000000
	s, err := NewState(now, DemoRules())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, c := range []Command{{Seq: 1, Kind: "queue", Station: 0, Recipe: 2}, {Seq: 2, Kind: "queue", Station: 1, Recipe: 1}, {Seq: 3, Kind: "boost"}} {
		if _, err := s.Apply(c, now); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	one, err := Decode(s.Encode())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	many, err := Decode(s.Encode())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := one.Advance(now + 25000); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for delta := int64(1000); delta <= 25000; delta += 1000 {
		if err := many.Advance(now + delta); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if one.Digest() != many.Digest() || one.Pending != 3 || one.IncomeRemainder != 5000 || one.Stations[0].Queue[0].Progress != 35000 || len(one.Stations[1].Ready) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("integration depends on timer frequency")
	}
	view := one.View()
	view.Stations[0].Queue[0].Progress = 0
	if reflect.DeepEqual(view.Stations, one.Stations) {
		t.Fatal("view aliases mutable queue")
	}
	// 收益封顶丢弃余数；任务满缓冲后丢弃时间，不让领取后恢复旧的溢出。
	capped, err := NewState(now, DemoRules())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	capped.Pending = 99
	capped.IncomeRemainder = 9000
	if err := capped.Advance(now + 30000); err != nil || capped.Pending != 100 || capped.IncomeRemainder != 0 {
		t.Fatal("pending income cap wrong", err)
	}
}
func TestIdleSimInvalidSnapshotsIdentitiesAndOverflowFailClosed(t *testing.T) {
	const now int64 = 1800000000000
	s, err := NewState(now, DemoRules())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, raw := range []string{s.Encode() + "{}", strings.Replace(s.Encode(), `"Gold":100`, `"Gold":-1`, 1), strings.Replace(s.Encode(), `"Schema":1`, `"Schema":9`, 1), strings.Replace(s.Encode(), `"IncomeLevel":1`, `"IncomeLevel":0`, 1)} {
		if _, err := Decode(raw); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid stored state accepted")
		}
	}
	for _, c := range []Command{{Seq: 0, Kind: "queue"}, {Seq: 2, Kind: "queue"}, {Seq: 1, Kind: "queue", Station: -1}, {Seq: 1, Kind: "queue", Recipe: 9}, {Seq: 1, Kind: "upload_balance", Count: 999999}} {
		local, _ := Decode(s.Encode())
		if _, err := local.Apply(c, now); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid command accepted")
		}
	}
	s.Gold = ValueLimit
	s.Pending = 1
	if _, err := s.Apply(Command{Seq: 1, Kind: "claim"}, now); err == nil || s.Gold != ValueLimit || s.Pending != 1 {
		t.Fatal("asset overflow accepted")
	}
	if _, err := NewState(MaxTime-1, DemoRules()); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("horizon overflow accepted")
	}
}
